summary: Shutterstock filed an 8-K disclosing a settlement with the FTC over alleged violations of the FTC Act and ROSCA related to subscription practices. The settlement includes a $35 million payment from cash on hand and changes to disclosure and cancellation practices. The FTC filed a complaint on May 13, 2026, and the parties agreed in principle to a stipulated order for permanent injunction and monetary judgment. This regulatory settlement constitutes an enforced operational restructuring of disclosure and subscription processes, though not a financial or legal reorganization. Watch for court approval and compliance implementation.
